notes.title: MAJOR UPDATES
notes.content:
[h1]🚘 [b]HELLO DETAILERS! [/b]🚘[/h1]

[h2][b] We have prepared a very big update for Car Detailings Simulator![/b] 🥳[/h2]

We would like to thank everyone who purchased our game for your amazing commitment both before and after the premiere. On Steam Community Hub and our Discord server, you have created an amazing community that has provided us with a lot of valuable information. We tried to meet most of your ideas, suggestions and expectations. Right NOW you can download first major updates. 😎

[h2][b]FULL LIST OF CHANGES:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] fixes for auctions and auction panel
[*] fix for red foam on seats
[*] fix for dirty lights and windows on cars spawned on auction slots

notes.title: Car Detailing Simulator DEVLOG #25 | Possibility to help us!
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome to another Car Detailing Simulator Devlog! [/h2]

Have you heard the good news? Our prologue is ready to download - FOR FREE! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1661270/Car_Detailing_Simulator_Prologue/

In this prologue, we decided to add a completely new option, what is more, after a strong analysis, we decided that this is probably one of the most important features we have ever created - especially that the reason behind it, is to make the game better and better for the final release - WITH YOU! 

You will find this new option in the [i]pause menu[/i] and it's called "[b]report error[/b]". After clicking this option, you will be moved to the website where in other to help us, you will be asked to answer some simple questions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38917699/cc8a788072f0e239abfe68f9c0cee0f14c97ead1.png[/img]

You will be able to choose what kind of error you decided to report. But, surprise! You can also express your feedback and even give us some of the ideas that were created during your gameplay. Sounds fun? 
You can also attach some screenshots or videos concerning the bug. It will help us truly understand the problem and fix it as soon as possible. 

Have you tried this option yet? If not, you are very welcome to help us in case you find something that is breaking the game or still needs some improvement. Your opinion really matters.

--------------------

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/cHCTwwvan9][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38917699/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png[/img][/url]

Car Detailing Simulator Team

notes.title: Car Detailing Simulator DEVLOG #12 | TASKS
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome to another Car Detailing Simulator Devlog! [/h2]

By playing our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1433570/Car_Detailing_Simulator/][b]DEMO[/b][/url] you have probably noticed that the orders you're taking are very diversified. Sometimes you will just need to wash a dirty car, but two orders later you will need to do literally EVERYTHING. It will not only take so much time, but at some point, you may also get a bit overwhelmed and about confused what you have already done and what task is still waiting for you. 

This is why we decided to make your life a bit easier at some point! After choosing an order a tab called "Mission" will appear on the right side of your screen. Thanks to this feature, at the very beginning of your order you can see what needs to be done and you can prepare yourself by, for example, buying the equipment that you need in this certain order. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38917699/f7e2a65412ff495a158e5b687fd42c5e2025a4b6.png[/img]

In this case you can of course choose what you want to do first, it's absolutely up to you. 🚗 

What is more, after you make some progress in the order it will be also visible on the right side! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38917699/574a7af466a7af0de96f3fd4f8723cd491eb7dd6.png[/img]

This feature allows you to see your each and every activity in the game, helps you to manage your tasks and of course, makes your work a bit easier 😊

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/cHCTwwvan9][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38917699/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Car Detailing Simulator DEVLOG #11 | AUCTIONS
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome to another Car Detailing Simulator Devlog! [/h2]

If you haven't played the Car Detailing Simulator demo yet, make sure to do it - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1433570/Car_Detailing_Simulator/][b]PLAY NOW[/b][/url]

Two weeks ago we presented the shed - a place where you can select certain cars, buy them, renovate and then... sell them! 🚗 

Today we will show you the [b]auction[/b] feature. It's easily accessible from the pie menu. We need to remember that we cannot sell cars that don't belong to us and only the ones that we bought from the shed. 

When our car is fully ready, we need to open the auction menu and select a car that we want to sell. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38917699/e9737d5f05530e77bc0446ab62f4129accf4a20a.png[/img]

Then we can set a price that will satisfy us to the fullest 😊 Of course we need to keep in mind that a higher amount of money will extend the sale time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38917699/3cbae0484bb6255f0e73495a00f098e32a9edd3c.png[/img]

What do you think about the auction? See you in the next devlog!

notes.title: Car Detailing Simulator DEVLOG #8 | SHED
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome to another Car Detailing Simulator Devlog! [/h2]

If you haven't played the Car Detailing Simulator demo yet, make sure to do it - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1433570/Car_Detailing_Simulator/][b]PLAY NOW[/b][/url]

Today we would like to show you a very cool feature in our game! We already know that by renovating and detailing the cars and by completing the quests we can earn a great deal of money 💰 But how do we spend them despite buying things and improvement in the shop? Here comes the [b]shed[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38917699/c6d5a01265b1b09329662bdf8d1a03691994194b.png[/img]

Of course, it's worth mentioning that not all the cars are unlocked from the very beginning, you need to spend some time to get them 😊

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38917699/cac84dd8bff60941f436c57dbfcebf73c8118267.png[/img]

When you pick a car you can see all the details including not only the price, but also the specifics such as engine or tires.

notes.title: Car Detailing Simulator DEVLOG #6 | MEMORIES MODE
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Everyone![/h2]

We are back with another Car Detailing Simulator devlog! Our team is working really hard on implementing various options for enhancing the gameplay. Today, we are presenting another interesting feature of the game - [b]memories mode[/b].

To trigger this option you need to go to the cork board and left-click on one of the photos pinned there. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38917699/673f0c247aadb04a84bae9f4360e963bb4986b71.png[/img]

Then you will see an interesting perspective of a car divided by the white line - the car on the left side is completely finished (by us of course! 😊). On the right side we can see the same car but in a previous state. We can easily move the line to the different sides and admire even a tiny detail of our work. Isn't it satisfying? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38917699/3b8f13c812069842cfcddcebc7a106020baeba75.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38917699/f40ed093aacf0e6befb6381c2a410e2695af9daa.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38917699/c17999cbba350ac3a4ad2c0f28e69120b8eb94e9.png[/img]

What do you think about the memories mode? Are you ready for more? 😊 

If you haven't played the Car Detailing Simulator demo yet, make sure to do - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1433570/Car_Detailing_Simulator/][b]PLAY NOW[/b][/url]

Stay tuned for another devlog!

notes.title: Car Detailing Simulator DEVLOG #5 | DEMO FEEDBACK & PHOTO MODE
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everybody! [/h2]

As you already know, Car Detailing Simulator was a part of Steam Next Fest from 16th to 22nd of June. Thanks again to [b]Larry Kosilla[/b] from [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCYsa8SOy3TkoxI5D17s1u-w][b]AMMO NYC[/b][/url] for [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R4IFazD1yuw]announcing[/url] the demo version of the game.

Your feedback was incredibly big and detailed, we were so happy that you asked many, various questions. Good to know that you are curious even about very small details :) 

Our Developers would like to thank you from the bottom of their hearts. They were really amazed and shocked by your enormous concern about the game. Together with the whole team, [b]thank you[/b]! ❤️ 

Thanks to your feedback we are able to release the patchnotes, so every single message from you matters :) 

If you haven't played the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1433570/Car_Detailing_Simulator/][b] DEMO[/b][/url] yet, there's still some time to do it. Feel free to share your experience with us! 

-------------------

Today we would like to show you the [b]photo mode[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38917699/ab024566abf22e3ca4319d3b2052692704a09af7.png[/img]

To open the photo mode you need to click on the middle mouse button and click on the little camera icon. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38917699/09be9164eae05fa64e1e66b1beade783db722e16.png[/img]

Then you will see various options that can combine with your creativity. You can move your camera, rotate it and modify many settings 📷

When you decide that your photo is absolutely ready, you can hang it on the wall. How cool is that? :) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38917699/ef40850cd9405e81bb5eea90ecfd75452b133000.png[/img]

Thank you and see you next time! 

[url=https://discord.gg/cHCTwwvan9][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38917699/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png[/img][/url]
